description: Send a decision to ID verified people before you act on it. Several people answer independently, each confirmed with Face ID, and you get back the consensus answer and how strongly they agreed. Use it for judgment calls where being wrong is costly: evals of AI output, tone and intent, whether two things match, moderation edge cases. Send refunds, payments and other money calls with route team. Write the question so a stranger can answer it from the context alone, and never include secrets or more personal data than the decision needs. Live keys use prepaid credit at $0.20 per answer (clips cost more by length), or $0.05 per internal vote with route team; test keys are free and simulated.

app.description: Which of the developer's apps this is for, like "support-agent". Default: PLURES_APP, then the default app

audio_url.description: An https recording people listen to in full before answering, such as a call your voice agent handled. Up to 3 minutes; needs media_seconds

category.description: A label the developer's routing rules match on, like "refunds"; the rule may choose the route and team

context.description: The material to judge, as plain text: the AI answer and the policy it should follow, the message, the listing

image_url.description: An https image shown with the question

instructions.description: Short guidance shown under the question

media_seconds.description: Length of the audio or video in seconds. Required with a clip

question.description: What people should decide, e.g. "Is this customer upset?"

route.description: verifiers (default) asks ID verified people first. team sends it straight to the developer's own people, for money and account decisions and confidential or policy calls; $0.05 per internal vote live

sensitive.description: Set true for violent, graphic or disturbing content, so only people who opted in see it, behind a warning

team.description: The name of one of the developer's teams, like "Finance", to decide instead of the main team

team_votes.description: With route team: how many people on the team vote; the majority decides

verifiers.description: How many people answer. Default 3; use 5 for higher stakes

video_url.description: An https video (MP4) people watch in full before answering. Up to 3 minutes; needs media_seconds. Not with audio_url

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the answer before returning a task_id to check later. Default 45, up to 240

name: ask_humans
title: Ask verified humans
